<TALK 1><NAME 1>He was friendly with the Arzuros, but...
he was mistaken for a fellow.
He was mistaken for his blue fur...

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CHAR 5,0,8,4,8><CV 2,10>Meow meow!
Could it be that's Galette, meow!?

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,6><CHAR 5,0,8,6,0>I've been looking for him, meow...
Long ago, meow,
something happened at a Felyne meet, meow.

<CV 2,2>While Galette did his trick,
'an Arzuros impression',
a real Arzuros appeared from behind, meow.

<CV 2,16>We scattered and fled,
but only Galette couldn't be found...

<CV 2,5>To think he was in such a place,
I never imagined, meow!

<CV 2,7><CHAR 5,0,8,7,0>But he's quite a reliable one, meow!
You should go adventuring together, meow!
